blocks.text: Casa Romantica

415 Avenida Granada; the 1927 Ole Hanson estate on the National Register of Historic Places, a bluff-top Spanish Colonial Revival wedding venue for up to 150 guests that also rents for corporate functions, holiday parties and retreats, and home to the Redmond Family Amphitheater by the Sea.

blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in San Clemente
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: San Clemente is a narrow bluff-top strip of coastal highway with almost no side parking and cliff-edge streets, so drop-and-go is mandatory for beach and bluff events.
Wedding weekends split groups between bluff-top venues, the pier and State Beach, which caps vehicle entry at 50 per event, making shuttling the standard plan.
The city's Pacific Coast Highway exit is the only way in and out and it queues hard at sunset.
About 40 miles from both LAX and SAN, which is exactly why airport pick-up service sells well here.

blocks.text: We also quote San Clemente to the hour rather than the trip. blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a San Clemente Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
